problems.problem: The recognition event is now half-built. The bounded product_silhouette primitive finally renders the true contour curve (neck, shoulder, waist flutes match image 2), but at the bottle's base line y=1043 the giant contour is still near full width (~400 px vs the bottle's 180 px), so the real bottle sits inside the silhouette's belly instead of filling its lower segment; no alignment seam exists at any height. The silhouette's base (y=1654) also lands ~470 px below the wall-floor junction (~y=1185), so the 'painted wall mural' runs down across the cement floor to the canvas bottom as a flat dark stripe - physically impossible for wall paint and it destroys the photographic set logic.
problems.root_cause: background.shapes primitive was sized/anchored to the canvas (x320,y80,440x1574) instead of being registered to the product's contact point and to the wall plane; the wall silhouette must share the bottle's base line and scale so the bottle occupies its lower portion.
problems.repair_strategy: Re-register the single product_silhouette primitive: keep source aspect (w/h 0.2796), set height 1300, width 364, base at the wall/floor junction y=1185 so y = 1185-1300 = -115 (top bleed is acceptable, crosses_canvas_edge already true), x = 540-364/2 = 358; then the bottle (base 1043, height 650) fills the silhouette's lower half and the seam between glass edge and painted edge becomes the visible event. Keep background.prompt as empty material/light so no generated arch returns.

problems.problem: The regenerated wall reads mid-to-dark grey (visibly darker than the palette anchor #C9C6C0, closer to #8f8d89 in the upper field) with a soft lateral gradient, contradicting the declared 'light even value, no gradient, no vignette'; the charcoal ink (#141210) title/subtitle therefore sit on a mid value and lose the crisp luxury ink read, and the dark silhouette loses contrast separation from the wall.
problems.root_cause: Generator tonality drifted below the palette anchor again while the prompt's evenness language was not reinforced with an explicit value target.
problems.repair_strategy: Regenerate with the same empty-material wording plus an explicit value instruction: wall at a pale warm grey near hex C9C6C0, fully flat matte, zero gradient or vignette, single diffuse frontal-overhead illumination described without equipment names; keep the executed #141210 ink which then reads at high contrast.

problems.problem: Product height ratio 0.4514 is inside the fresh-concept policy (0.35-0.74), so no size rule is broken; artistically, however, once the silhouette is re-registered to the bottle the left column (title block top-left, logo bottom-left) leaves a large dead mid-left field, and against references 3-5 the packshot-plus-graphic mass still reads recessive rather than dominant.
problems.root_cause: Composition was balanced for the old arch position; the re-registered silhouette shifts visual weight to centre-right without a counterweight in the left column.
problems.repair_strategy: After re-registering the silhouette, raise title size from 84 to 92 and subtitle tracking from 3 to 5 to strengthen the left column, and enable a small matte-red (#D6231F) rectangle decoration (x 76, y 300, width 56, height 8 implied by width field) as a concept accent tying the palette's red into the typography column; keep the asymmetric grid intentional.

problems.problem: The supplied contact detail crop (370,903-710,1153) confirms the bottle is NOT floating: a soft dark seam sits exactly under the glass heel at base y=1043 with offset_y=0, and droplets/heel glass are untouched. Do not move the shadow down. Remaining weakness: because the dark silhouette stripe passes behind and below the base, the contact seam partly merges into the dark stripe at poster scale, weakening the single-layer grounding cue.
problems.root_cause: Shadow footprint (width_scale 1.35, opacity 0.42) is adequate on light cement but loses separation where the silhouette stripe crosses the floor behind the heel.
problems.repair_strategy: Keep offset_y 0 and kind contact; once the silhouette base is lifted to the wall junction the heel will sit on light cement again - then slightly raise opacity to 0.46 and blur to 16 so the seam reads alone without dark-stripe competition.
